sloka: यदृच्छया एव गाम् प्राप्तौ देव लोकात् इव अमरौ ।कथम् पद्भ्याम् इह प्राप्तौ किम् अर्थम् कस्य वा मुने ॥१-५०-१९॥
transliteration: yadṛcchayā eva gām prāptau deva lokāt iva amarau ।katham padbhyām iha prāptau kim artham kasya vā mune ॥1-50-19॥

translations.english: "O Sage (Viswamitra), be blessed. Who are these two young men with the prowess of the celestials the gait of an elephant or a lion? They resemble a tiger or a bull in courage. They have large eyes like lotuspetals. They are armed with scimitars bows and quivers. With their approaching youth, they resemble the Aswinikumaras in beauty. They look like gods who have descended on earth from heaven out of their free will. Whose sons are they? How did they come here on foot? And for what purpose?
